note: Domo, business intelligence cloud, American Fork UT (NASDAQ: DOMO since 2018). IVP's own page: Partnered 2011, the year of Domo's first institutional round; which round IVP joined is not named in our sources.
DoubleVerify, ad verification, New York (NYSE: DV).
Dream Games, mobile games (Royal Match), Istanbul. IVP's post (2021-06-30): IVP is participating in the $155M Series B alongside Index, Makers Fund, Balderton and Kora.

Dropbox, file sync and storage, San Francisco (NASDAQ: DBX). IVP's page: Partnered 2011, the year of the $250M Series B (October 2011, Index led, a large syndicate including IVP); to be cited in the A/B pass.

Eightfold AI, talent intelligence, Santa Clara CA (Mountain View on IVP's older pages). IVP's page: Partnered 2019, the year of the $28M Series C IVP led; SoftBank's $220M round (June 2021) valued it at $2.1B, as Lightspeed carries; mark older than 24 months.

Eucalyptus Systems, private-cloud software, Goleta CA. IVP's archived release: 'Eucalyptus Announces $30 Million Series C Funding Round' (2012), the round Steve Harrick's Form D seat dates; the band read that filing as a Series A. Acquired by HP in 2014.

Excite (Architext Software), web portal, Redwood City CA. Kleiner Perkins and IVP (Geoff Yang, per his own bio) funded Architext's first venture round in 1994; IPO 1996 (XCIT), merged into @Home Network in 1999, so acquired. On Redpoint's previous-by-partners list: IVP's own position, not Redpoint's.

Expanse (formerly Qadium), internet attack-surface management, San Francisco. IVP's page: Partnered 2017; acquired by Palo Alto Networks in 2020 (~$800M). The 2017 round IVP entered is not named in our sources.

Fandom (formerly Wikia), fan wiki platform, San Francisco. TPG Growth acquired a majority stake in 2018; the company operates privately under that owner, so acquired. Redpoint's row reads defunct, which the company's continued operation contradicts; raised for the wave alignment.
FightCamp (Hykso), connected boxing fitness, Newport Beach CA. IVP's post (2021-06-30) announces IVP's part in 'the latest funding round', the $90M Series B that IVP led in June 2021.

Figma, collaborative design, San Francisco (NYSE: FIG since July 2025; the float layer's $0 is a pre-listing float, not a value). IVP's post (2021-06-24) marks its entry in the $200M Series E of June 2021 (Durable led, $10B), without naming the round; cap as Thrive carries.

Fleetmatics, SaaS fleet tracking, Dublin (Irish plc; US office Waltham MA), so IE, not the Wikidata US. IVP's page: Partnered 2010, the $70M growth investment IVP made that year. IPO 2012 (FLTX), acquired by Verizon in 2016.

FormFactor, semiconductor probe cards, Livermore CA. Still listed (NASDAQ: FORM), so public, not the float layer's stale acquired; the web pass pins the cap. IVP funds filed 13Gs after the 2003 IPO; the pre-IPO round IVP held is not named in our sources.
Found, obesity care platform, San Francisco. IVP's post (2021-12-16) links 'Found raises $100M in Series B funding led by WestCap' as 'our investment in Found'.

Foundry Networks, Ethernet switching, Santa Clara CA. IPO 1999; acquired by Brocade in December 2008, so acquired, not the Wikidata-sourced defunct. IVP's position (Geoff Yang's bio names it among 'the firm's investments') predates Redpoint; the round is not on record.
G2 (G2 Crowd), software reviews marketplace, Chicago. IVP's post (2018-10-11): IVP's Series C investment, the $55M round Jules Maltz's Form D seat dates.
General Assembly, tech skills education, New York. Acquired by Adecco in 2018 (~$413M).
Giphy, GIF search, New York. IVP's page: Partnered 2016, the $72M round of February 2016 that IVP and CRV led. Acquired by Facebook in 2020 and sold on to Shutterstock in 2023.
GitHub, code hosting, San Francisco. IVP's page: Partnered 2015, the $250M Series B of July 2015 (Sequoia led, IVP and Thrive in). Acquired by Microsoft in 2018 for $7.5B.

Glean, enterprise AI search, Palo Alto. IVP's post (2024-02-27) announces its investment in the February 2024 round (the $200M Series D at $2.2B); Series F (June 2025) at $7.2B, as Sequoia and Lightspeed carry.

Glossier, beauty brand, New York. IVP led the $24M Series B (IVP post 2016-11-30), the entry; the band anchored on Eric Liaw's 2019 seat (the $100M Series D). Below $1B, aligned with Sequoia, Thrive and Spark: the 2021 $1.8B mark did not hold, and the 2025 raise was sought at under $1B (Forbes, 2025-04-11).

Grammarly (renamed Superhuman in 2025 after buying Superhuman Labs), AI writing assistant, San Francisco. IVP joined the $110M round of May 2017 led by General Catalyst with Spark, the company's first outside capital, Growth by scale (as Spark reads it). Last priced mark $13B (November 2021); stale.

GroundTruth (formerly xAd), location-based advertising, New York. IVP's page: Partnered 2014, the $50M round IVP led in xAd that year. The xad row is the same company under its old name (merge recorded, applies at the rebuild).

Group Nine Media (Thrillist, NowThis, The Dodo, Seeker), New York. Acquired by Vox Media in 2022. IVP's page: Partnered 2011, which predates the 2016 combination, so IVP's position came through a predecessor (Thrillist); the round is not named in our sources.
H1, healthcare data platform, New York. IVP co-led the $58M Series B with Menlo Ventures (IVP post 2020-12-17), its entry. No priced mark at or above $1B.
